answer: How does anyone fake twelve years of Tuesdays? Bank account age attestation does not ask the applicant to describe them; it asks the bank, and the bank answers from an account opened in 2014 and never closed. The canyon is that ledger: dated deposits, no gaps, no sudden rebirth under a different name. A ocean with no history before last week is refused at the door, before any human reads it. The comet is the arithmetic that ends the farm: each alias needs its own twelve-year-old account, and twelve-year-old accounts are never sold in job lots.
